description: A Tasks row with a name is launched by that name: `worker --task` resolves a unique name to its item, so the coordinator needs no lookup of its own.
prompt: Start the upload audit. For this isolated test, use --dry-run for the worker launch and do not start a real worker process.

graders.name: reads the dispatch skill before the first launch, worktree, models call or tracker write
graders.rule: Pass the row's `name` cell as `--task`; it resolves to the one row with that name.

graders.name: worker launched by the task's name
